purpose: Repository-only current-state authority that separates GoreeCloud product/source lifecycle from the live production runtime or predecessor that remains authoritative during controlled migrations.

goreecloud-memos.transition: GoreeCloud Memos web/server v0.1.3 is the accepted Stable production runtime.

goreecloud-notify.transition: GoreeCloud Notify 0.2.0 remains a Release Candidate. ntfy v2.26.3 remains the active production notification service and rollback path until target acceptance, controlled producer and consumer migration, tested rollback, and explicit cutover are complete.

goreecloud-search.transition: GoreeCloud Search remains the current production search service, while its existing SearXNG-derived implementation is transitional continuity during the mandatory native rebuild. Native Stable qualification requires separate implementation and acceptance evidence.

goreecloud-monitor.transition: Uptime Kuma remains the active and authoritative GoreeCloud availability-monitoring platform until GoreeCloud Monitor completes target recovery, isolated deployment, reviewed activation, live parity and scenario validation, rollback evidence, and explicit cutover approval.
